$comment: Single source of truth for every route the app serves. Generated lists (sitemap.xml, the prerendered per-route index.html files, and the static server's 404 allowlist) are all derived from this file at build time by scripts/emit-routes.mjs -- do not hand-edit any of them. kind: 'public' is indexable and needs meta; 'app' is a real route that is private or carries params, so it is served but never indexed; 'internal' is development-only and is dropped from the production build entirely.
